pairs.sql: SELECT SUM(pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01';

pairs.rewritten: 2024年有效订单的平均订单金额是多少？
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(pay_amount) AS avg_order_amount FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01';

pairs.rewritten: 2024年有多少个不同用户下过有效订单？
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01';

pairs.rewritten: 2024年销售额最高的商品品类是哪个？它的销售额是多少？
pairs.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成') AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 1
